description: This file defines a React component called 'RecommendationGrid' that fetches and displays a grid of role recommendations based on a user's persona. It includes internal utility functions, styling logic, and a sub-component 'RoleCardHiFi' for rendering individual role cards with details such as salary, experience, responsibilities, and skills.

classes.name: RecommendationRole
classes.description: TypeScript type representing a role recommendation, including role ID, title, industry, salary, experience, description, key responsibilities, and required skills.

classes.name: RoleCardHiFi
classes.description: React component for rendering a high-fidelity recommendation role card with styling and detailed information such as salary, experience, responsibilities, and skills.

methods.name: joinUrl
methods.description: Utility function to concatenate base URL and path segments, ensuring proper slash handling.

methods.name: skillChipStyle
methods.description: Returns style objects for skill chips depending on whether the skill is a mastery, growth, or neutral skill.

methods.name: normalizeSkill
methods.description: Utility to trim and convert skill strings to lowercase for consistent matching.

methods.name: extractPersonaSkillsWithProficiency
methods.description: Extracts an array of skills with proficiency levels from the persona object, considering various possible properties.

methods.name: computeMasteryGrowthSets
methods.description: Analyzes persona skills to categorize them into mastery (≥80%) and growth (20-60%) sets.
